subject: Schedule for 1.1.0 to be on CRAN?

messages.author: 7dfb45b1bf1d7262
messages.subject: Schedule for 1.1.0 to be on CRAN?
parts:
Dear hBayesDM users,

I've been wanting to fit the new bart_ewmv model for a while but failed to install the latest 1.1.0 release via git, despite installing rtools40 correctly on windows 10 (rtan tested with no problems), warning messages below:

Warning messages:
1: In untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  failed to copy ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/Python/hbayesdm/common/../../../commons/extdata’ to ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/Python/hbayesdm/common/extdata’
2: In untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  failed to copy ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/Python/hbayesdm/common/../../../commons/stan_files’ to ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/Python/hbayesdm/common/stan_files’
3: In untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  failed to copy ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/R/inst/../../commons/extdata’ to ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/R/inst/extdata’
4: In untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  failed to copy ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/R/inst/../../commons/stan_files’ to ‘CCS-Lab-hBayesDM-eaeca1a/R/inst/stan_files’
5: In untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  skipping pax global extended headers
6: In untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  skipping pax global extended headers

I've also tried to install the new release by zip/tar.gz files with no success.

So I wonder, when do you plan to put the new release on CRAN? : )

Many Thanks and Kind Regards,
Crystal

messages.author: 77a287453637d027
messages.subject: Re: Schedule for 1.1.0 to be on CRAN?
parts:
Hi Crystal,

Sorry for your inconvenience with the latest version of hBayesDM.

For now, we'd like to ask you to use the previous version v1.0.2, unless you're interested in the new models added in v1.1.0.

I'm working on it to fix several issues with the latest version, and the fixed version will be released within a week.

Again, sorry for your inconvenience, and please stay tuned for the upcoming release.

Best,
Jaeyeong
